summary: A description of the Telnet logger and server for the CP/CMS system on the Lincoln Laboratory 360/67, listed as host 10. It serves half and full duplex users with ASCII or EBCDIC data, uses the hide-input and no-echo controls during login, and follows the initial connection protocol. The text says it was not cleared for public release.

eli5.summary: A guide to how one particular computer lets people sign in remotely by typing, including how it handles passwords being hidden.
